evidence.quote: Fed policymakers intend to keep interest rates low for a considerable time to promote a stronger economic recovery, a substantial improvement in labor market conditions, and greater progress toward maximum employment in a context of price stability.
A broader measure of underemployment that includes these and other potential workers stands at 14.3 percent.
Furthermore, wage growth has remained more muted than is typical during an economic recovery.
use the unconventional policy tools to bring longer-term interest rates such as mortgage rates down further.
Our country cannot achieve prosperity without addressing the powerful undertow created by flat wages and tenuous financial security for so many millions of Americans.
